response.justification: The candidate lacks the two mandatory requirements for this role: substantial C++ development experience (5-10 years on Windows platform) and financial-services domain expertise. While the resume demonstrates strong general software engineering fundamentals and diverse technical skills, there is no evidence of capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or capital banking experience. The limited C++ work noted (2014-2015 at National Instruments) is both dated and insufficient in scope and platform specialization.
strengths: Demonstrates strong software craftsmanship principles (TDD, CI/CD, testing practices) applicable to critical systems development
Proven adaptability across multiple programming languages and platforms, showing capability to learn new technologies
Excellent communication and leadership skills evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and open-source project stewardship
concerns: Lacks mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development experience; most recent C++ work was in 2014-2015 at National Instruments
No experience in financial services domain, capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or capital banking
No demonstrated expertise with SQL Server or Oracle; experience limited to MySQL and generic SQL
